items.title: Palestinians to bury remains of 105 people killed in Israeli attack on Gaza
items.description: Coffins containing the remains of those killed will be carried in a funeral procession involving family members.

items.title: Israelis divided as vote that could oust Netanyahu only weeks away

items.title: Russia launches major attack on Ukraine’s energy grid, causing power cuts
items.description: Russia launched its heaviest combined assault on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure in months on Wednesday, killing seven people and triggering emergency power cuts in Kyiv and nearby regions. The strikes came as officials warned of a difficult winter amid Russian attacks on Ukraine’s power and heating infrastructure.

items.title: Rosenberg: Putin shows no sign of stopping the war as Russia doubles down on Ukraine
items.description: A foreign policy speech by the Russian president will be keenly watched, but all signs point to the full-scale invasion continuing.

items.title: Gaza: NGO reports dire camp conditions, says Israel is moving 'Yellow Line'
items.description: The Danish Refugee Council alleges that Israel is employing "a policy of protracted displacement" in Gaza. It says the so-called "Yellow Line" is creeping west toward the coast, preventing many from returning home.

items.title: Ukraine Delivers Food By Drone As Russian-Occupied Oleshky Faces Starvation
items.description: Oleshky, a Ukrainian city occupied by Russian forces 9 kilometers from Kherson, is on the brink of a humanitarian catastrophe. Since the occupation and the subsequent bombing of the Kakhovka Hydroelectric Power Station in 2023, the city has been without electricity, gas, or drinking water. Now, Kyiv says locals are sta…

items.title: What we know about the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv
items.description: A flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after one of the pilots stabbed the other. Israeli authorities have not ruled out the possibility of a terrorist attack or a suicide attempt.

items.title: Malaysia: UN agency urges safeguards after refugees returned to Myanmar
items.description: The UN refugee agency, UNHCR, has voiced concern over Malaysia’s decision to return 1,476 people to Myanmar amid an ongoing civil war and a dire human rights and humanitarian situation.

items.title: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
items.description: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

items.title: Putin Envoy, U.S. Officials Discussed Ukraine War and Energy Initiatives, U.S. Official Says
items.description: Dmitriev had meetings with representatives of the U.S. Treasury and Energy departments during his visit to Washington, sources told Reuters.

items.title: ‘Contempt for Science and Truth’: Macron Condemns Russian Strike on Kyiv Academy
items.description: French President Emmanuel Macron condemned Monday’s strike on Ukraine’s National Academy of Sciences, saying France and Europe would continue to support Ukraine. Two people were killed in the attack on the academy building, while strikes across Kyiv left dozens injured.

items.title: Why island nations are the real winners as UN wraps up
items.description: The U.N. hears that a billion people are on the front line as sea levels rise due to climate change.
